limits.value: 64 MB of RAM, 2 GB of disk

record.binding_note: 10 GB a month is 341 MB a day, 0.9% of 1 TiB, so the volume fails first; behind it the 15-day term ends the server, and 64 MB of RAM is below what a WireGuard endpoint can be relied on to run

identity_cost.detail: the order goes through a cart at cart.lusovps.com with no card term stated on the product page; the checkout flow was not read

record.reliability_note: the free term is 15 days and the server is then deleted or converted to the EUR 3.50 a month plan
record.confidence_note: the specification table and the 'FREE for 15 days' price line are on the product page read; no probe was run

evidence.proved: the free plan reads '64MB RAM', '2GB Hard Drive', '10GB Traffic @ 100Mbps', '5 IPv6 Addresses' and 'Price: FREE for 15 days'
the paid twin of the same shape is 'EUR 3.50EUR monthly', so the free 15 days is a trial of a paid product

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 0 for 15 days, then EUR 3.50 a month
record.notes: Provides an IPv6-only virtual machine with 10 GB of bandwidth on a 15-day promotional trial. Standard paid IPv6 plans are priced at EUR 3.50 monthly.

extras.wg_detail: a Xen VPS with five IPv6 addresses and a SolusVM panel, so wg-quick is native over IPv6; 64 MB of RAM is the practical constraint, since the kernel module plus sshd plus wg-quick is a tight fit and a userspace fallback would not fit at all
extras.transit_note: bytes leave over IPv6 at up to 100 Mbps
